warnings: Production amplification may place up to 40 somersloops in each phase's plan, and this plan uses 40. Each phase is a self-contained steady state, so that budget is per phase rather than a running total: the somersloops move as you rebuild. Amplified machines are whole machines at 100% — same inputs, double output, four times the power — and the recipe network is chosen before amplification is fitted to it, so the result is not a global optimum over amplified and unamplified recipes together.
Resource budgets are provisional. Confirm available extraction after reserving resources for existing factories.
Phase targets assume that phase’s milestones and required MAM research are unlocked. Gathered items, buildings and equipment are not continuously automated.

Power includes new generators and their fuel chains, the miners and extractors (Miner Mk.3 at 250% on normal nodes), and a 20% allowance on the production lines for trains, drone ports and pumps. Machines count at their clocked power; Particle Accelerators, Converters and Quantum Encoders at their peak. Generators are whole and run at 100%, burning fuel only for the power drawn, and a phase keeps the generators the phase before built. Existing plants are represented only by spare capacity; subtract their fuel from available resources. Drone fuel is a separate protected supply contract, not a route-consumption estimate.
Maximum output optimizes elevator completion within the entered budgets and allowed recipes; it is not an unrestricted global game optimum.
